status.scope: Seven accepted native one-block cells at actual J2048/J21120. Saved-source-method upstream BF16 capture parity and direct native F32 panel parity. Graph-call coalescing only; no material repeatable production gain established.

problem.trigger: Full attention makes180 of195 Graph calls; test softmax/PV coalescing without changing numerical boundaries.
problem.falsifier: Any unchanged-tolerance/nonfinite/capture failure, altered waits/readbacks/lifetime/budgets, unmatched inputs/work, or lack of material repeatable whole-block benefit blocks promotion.
problem.strongest_failure: A compiler reduction changes behind a BF16 boundary or fewer API calls merely move waits while retaining GPU work.
problem.rollback: Omit diagnostic opt-in flags or revert this atomic change. Default production selection stays separate.

method.candidate: One MPSGraph invocation computes rank4 axis3 F32 softmax and rank3 batch32 F32 PV; both probability and attended outputs remain materialized. No demonstrated kernel fusion.
method.fixed: BF16 gather/scatter; separate F32 QK and custom scaling; geometry,inputs,weights,separate gate/up and unchanged2e-5 atol/rtol.
method.owner: Two independently prepared native Plans share every binding under one serialized lifetime; both alternatives prepared in both Plans; selection immutable after first encode.
method.correctness_only: Every local tile snapshots selected P/Y, computes alternate on same scores/V, compares in F32 with baseline reference, restores selected P/Y before scatter. Six requests per geometry; excluded from speed estimates.
method.guard: Fresh file-cache-aware admission every launch,10%floor,14GiBfull/8GiBsmall process caps,64MiBswap-growth stop,240sdeadline.
method.gpu_contract: Zero tracked named allocations/preterminal activation reads; one existing terminal wait/request. One128Bnormal or176Bcorrectness-only metrics read after wait.

verification.commands_and_raw_receipts: Exact commands, pre-execution source/artifact pins and guard logs are dereferenced by the external numerical and quality audits; use them rather than reconstructing historical argv from prose.

limitations: Sparse matched profiled diagnostic timings do not establish significance,equivalence or production speed.
Root unions include stalls and diagnostic poison/comparisons; nested host timings and overlapping counters are not additive.
Saved pinned upstream-source-method MPS fixtures are not an independent backend or newly executed full upstream block.
Direct F32 checks compare native alternatives; no saved upstream F32 local panels exist.
Real latent/noise/stem input is not DiT-denoised video; no full decoder/head/diffusion/generation or video-quality result.
Both Plans retain both alternatives,so no minimal-candidate opaque-memory reduction was measured.
Sampled guards do not bound transients or a continuous floor; device residual does not identify a leak/cache mechanism.
Earlier intermittent pre-request ownership failure and full36 drift remain unexplained.
excluded_or_superseded: Earlier C++ range-loop and Metal grid-signature compile failures precede accepted final source/build.
Early offline auditor had a wrong BF16 NaN word-difference expectation; v3 matches the existing injection-after-word-compare comparator.
An inline negative-check harness expected a wrong legacy exception substring; the saved process rejected correctly and the quality audit verifies it without rerunning.
decision: Keep the candidate diagnostic and default separate. A 60-Graph-call reduction produces only a sparse approximately 0.10% whole-block advantage, with 128 roots unchanged. Test actual F32 FFN/GEMM kernel execution cost next.
next_falsifier: Identical-operand full-J F32 FFN/GEMM experiment must pass the same upstream gates and lower whole-block root union and request wall time; Graph-wrapper reductions alone are insufficient.

decay.refresh_on: Scoped source/artifact/backend/device/OS/toolchain,geometry/precision,commands,captures,lifetime,guards or clock changes,or evidence loss.
decay.failure_policy: Reopen dependent claim and leave candidate disabled; no silent tolerance widening.
